requirements.statement: Compile one component-category resolver per folder dataset without changing fallback, workspace, cycle, label, or path outputs.
Centralize the three production upload-route Bearer checks behind one timing-safe server-only boundary while preserving response behavior.

Make upload-removal eligibility per category-qualified asset and return disjoint claimed, blocked, and already-removed path sets without changing final purge protection or category-ineligible active-asset behavior.
Move the concrete Estimate-tree D1 read and build implementation out of the workspace repository while retaining workspace and authorization orchestration there.
Give component-folder move serialization, generations, confirmed targets, and stale-result decisions one narrow coordinator shared by both real UI adapters.
Move component and folder D1 statement graphs into two concrete deep modules while server actions retain auth, parsing, public errors, and revalidation.
Move durable public rate-limit D1 and engine mechanics to shared security infrastructure while publication and Client Portal policies remain domain-owned and behavior-identical.
Delete the stringly Estimate D1 query and action facade and replace every consumer with concrete typed intent modules.
Deepen the existing per-sheet editable-row store into the single owner of row commit intent, dirty, pending, authoritative, optimistic, and rollback state.

assumptions.statement: No second storage implementation currently justifies a generic repository interface or factory for the retained concrete D1 modules.
All previously active codebase-agent owners are terminal and the frozen worktree is clean; implementation remains valid only inside a standalone write window.

risks.statement: Compiled category resolution changes fallback, cycle, workspace, label, or path behavior.
Shared Bearer authorization changes route status, message, scheme parsing, or secret handling.
Estimate-tree extraction creates a repository cycle or changes query, access, legacy fallback, limit, ordering, or tree output behavior.
An older component-folder move completion overwrites or rolls back a newer optimistic intent.
Component D1 relocation changes statement order, fanout, receipts, revision behavior, error translation, or atomicity.
Rate-limit relocation changes scope, key, metadata, window, threshold, consumption, clearing, message, or cleanup behavior.
Estimate facade retirement changes high-risk row, history, revision, receipt, template, projection, access, or atomic mutation behavior.
Row-store deepening causes render storms, focus loss, duplicate-retry identity or rollback drift, shared-versus-row-owned mutation drift, or a server/client boundary violation.
Per-asset upload classification creates overlapping result sets, mislabels category-ineligible active assets, or weakens final reference protection.

criteria.test_rationale: The critical invariant is identical category fallback and path output for every folder topology; cheaper type and source evidence is insufficient to prove behavior parity.
The critical invariant is unchanged 503 and 401 denial behavior across three internal routes; cheaper source inspection is insufficient to prove every response branch.
The critical invariant is identical Estimate tree, tab, ordering, limit, and legacy fallback output; cheaper import and type evidence is insufficient to prove it.
The critical invariant is latest-intent preservation with authoritative rollback under racing component moves; cheaper static evidence is insufficient to prove promise ordering.
The critical invariant is transaction-coupled component, fanout, revision, receipt, and folder behavior; cheaper source relocation evidence is insufficient to prove atomic parity.
The critical invariant is identical durable lockout, counting, clearing, and retry behavior; cheaper source and import evidence is insufficient to prove it.

The critical invariant is identical Estimate write, history, revision, receipt, projection, and authorization behavior after facade deletion; the Admin map must also stop naming the deleted file, and cheaper no-residual evidence is insufficient.

The critical invariant is correct row-owned versus shared-definition routing with focus-safe optimistic rollback and preserved duplicate retry identity; cheaper prop and selector inspection is insufficient to prove interaction behavior.

The critical invariant is independent per-asset claim eligibility over a category-qualified matched set, with disjoint truthful result sets, preserved not_found behavior for category-ineligible active assets, and unchanged final purge protection; cheaper source evidence cannot prove mixed-batch behavior.

units.goal: Compile and reuse one component-category resolver per loaded folder dataset while preserving the isolated-call API.
Replace three duplicated production upload-route Bearer checks with one timing-safe server-only boundary and identical route responses.
Make upload-removal eligibility per category-qualified asset and return disjoint truthful claimed, blocked, and already-removed path sets while preserving category-ineligible active-asset behavior.
Extract concrete Estimate-tree D1 reads and builders without moving workspace or authorization orchestration.
Replace duplicated component-folder move generations and rollback logic with one narrow framework-free coordinator.
Move component and folder D1 statement graphs into two concrete deep modules while preserving the server-action boundary.
Relocate durable public rate-limit storage and engine mechanics to shared security modules while preserving domain policy semantics.
Replace the faux Estimate query and string action dispatcher with typed concrete intent modules and delete the facade file.
Deepen the existing per-sheet editable-row store into the single owner of row commit routing, dirty state, pending state, and rollback while preserving duplicate retry identity and isolated rollback.

decisions.statement: This master supersedes both predecessor packs; no predecessor backlog item survives without current-source proof and an explicit crosswalk disposition.
Deep modules hide cohesive implementation; generic factories, compatibility re-exports, and pass-through wrappers are prohibited.
The implementation task explicitly authorizes all exact test-source maintenance and test execution; every unit is ready, while only the exact next_unit may start.

Implementation runs in one standalone write window; historical leases are cleared and the active goal explicitly authorizes every exact test-source maintenance edit and focused test command in this pack.
Quantity and selected variant remain row-owned while shared component-definition edits remain shared for linked Library and shared project component or variant definitions.
Rate-limit behavior relocates before any semantic convergence with invite, AI, privacy, admin, upload, or Estimate limiters.

Applied migrations, admin feature or content work, Legacy Cleanup, estimate import, hosted proof, and unmeasured performance proposals remain outside core scope; preserved valid findings have stable follow-up IDs and upload-removal correctness is core.
The active implementation goal converts every listed focused product-test command to TEST_TASK authority; each criterion still requires a fresh passing receipt before verification.
Admin Estimate System feature and content work stays excluded; UNIT-007 owns the exact sources.persistence retarget to d1-intents/database.ts before deleting the facade that entry names.
